name: badge
gotchas: `matBadge` is an attribute directive applied directly to the host element (an icon, a button, etc.) — there is no separate `<mat-badge>` tag, so nesting an element inside another expecting badge behavior does nothing.

The badge's accessible label defaults to reading out the badge content itself (e.g. "5") unless you set `matBadgeDescription` to something more meaningful like "5 unread messages" for screen reader users.

Setting `matBadge=""` (empty string) still renders an empty badge dot — use `matBadgeHidden` to actually remove the badge from layout and the accessibility tree, rather than trying to hide it by clearing the content.
